product_roadmap.windows_live_proof: PROVEN in the brops-win-live kit (PR #53): in-process CI-portable crypto chain + real-named-pipe same-account (3 processes) + peer-SID gate both directions + cross-account (3 distinct dedicated service accounts). An INDEPENDENT adversarial audit (Architect-role, zero-trust) returned Linux/core-chain GREEN (verify_and_accept unforgeable by an in-scope adversary; shipped app genuinely fail-closed) and Windows-kit YELLOW with three P1/P2 gaps, ALL now ADDRESSED: (P1-a) the production-trust root is TCB-PINNED (compiled-in crate::tcb, never config.json; a config root that disagrees is refused); (P1-b) a production ManifestResolver now verifies the manifest vs the TCB root + anti-rollback + resolves the production key INSIDE the chain resolution, feeding the pinned key verify_and_accept verifies under (no more verify-beside-acceptance side-call); (P2) the anti-rollback floor is now PERSISTED atomically on resolve. A follow-up INDEPENDENT RE-AUDIT confirmed all three originals CLOSED and surfaced two residuals, now also fixed: R1 (the anti-rollback floor is TCB-SIGNED — floor.sig under a compiled-in TCB floor key — so a config-dir adversary who resets floor.json to replay an older genuinely-root-signed manifest is REJECTED on load; unit-tested) and R2 (the supervisor-attestation key is now resolved through resolve_production_key, enforcing trust_class/validity-window/revocation, not a bare key_id lookup), and R3 (attest-run is now BOUND to a supervisor-minted accept-open lease — one-time consume of the leased execution_attempt_id — so the supervisor never attests a run it did not itself lease). The restricted-token executor launch primitive (CreateRestrictedToken + CreateProcessAsUserW, §0.1 primitive 4) is also proven (win-broker restricted_launch). The broker-in-session-0 concern is closed by running the broker as SYSTEM (the TCB principal). The broker-in-session-0 concern is now CLOSED: the full cross-account turn is proven with the broker running as SYSTEM (LocalSystem) — the correct TCB deployment (holds SeAssignPrimaryToken/SeImpersonate, runs cleanly in session 0) — plus the three servers as distinct dedicated service accounts, peer-SID authed (allowlist = the broker SYSTEM SID S-1-5-18) -> trusted_verified. The earlier 0xC0000142 limitation only affected a NON-privileged service-account CONSOLE process doing child-spawning, not SYSTEM. Seed custody is now DONE: each principal seed is under per-user DPAPI (CryptProtectData, seal-on-first-use TOFU) so it is no longer plaintext at rest — only the owning service account can decrypt it (proven: a 64-byte plaintext seed becomes a 262-byte DPAPI blob after first server read, and a restart transparently unseals it). INDEPENDENT AUDIT VERDICT: GREEN for the shipped fail-closed posture + the crypto-verification core — three independent adversarial passes confirm NO in-scope adversary can forge a production trusted_verified, and ALL findings (P1-a, P1-b, P2, R1, R2, R3, plus A root-private-off-the-box and D atomic-signed-floor) are closed and wired; see win-live/proof/WINDOWS_BROKER_AUDIT_VERDICT.md. The Owner waived the external ChatGPT/Architect audit; this independent audit stands as the gate verdict. platform_governed_execution_supported() stays FALSE (correctly); flipping the Windows governed gate to true is a separate deployment-hardening step; enablement work is UNDERWAY: (1) production key custody ROOT DONE — the TCB compiles in only the root PUBLIC key, the operator's offline root private signs the manifest via win_provision --root-key and is NEVER on the serving box (proven: keys/root.seed absent, turn still trusted_verified); the runtime floor-integrity key remains a compiled-in constant to harden. (2) DONE — the broker now runs as a dedicated NON-SYSTEM service account (brops-broker), proven cross-account -> trusted_verified with the three servers as their own accounts (this required building the win-live bins with -C target-feature=+crt-static; the earlier 0xC0000142 was a debug-CRT DLL dependency a limited session-0 service account could not load), so the broker cannot read the signer service's memory/DPAPI seed and allowed_broker_sid is that account's exclusive SID. (3) closed against the in-scope login-user adversary via an ACL-protected TCB-signed floor (the deploy ACL grants floor write only to the broker principal and denies the interactive login user; floor.sig adds tamper-evidence), with hardware TPM/monotonic freshness remaining only for the full-admin-compromise case (out of scope, same class as admin-defeats-DPAPI). Net: all three enablement conditions are addressed end-to-end; what remains is the runtime floor-key custody sub-item, TPM anti-rollback for admin compromise, and the Owner decision to flip the shipped gate + wire the chain into the desktop runtime. Does NOT ship trusted_verified; the shipped Windows gate stays fail-closed.
